title: 1954 AHSME Problem 46
statement: In the diagram, if points \(A,\) \(B,\) and \(C\) are points of tangency, then \(x\) equals:

solutions.text:
The radius is \(\frac{3}{16}\) inch. The center lies on the angle bisector. The perpendicular radius to either sloping side and the segment from the vertex to the center form a right triangle with a \(30^\circ\) angle, so the center is \[ \frac{\frac{3}{16}}{\sin30^\circ}=\frac38 \] inch above the vertex. Hence the top tangent is \(\frac{3}{8}+\frac{3}{16}=\frac{9}{16}\) inch above the vertex. Since the ledge is \(\frac{1}{2}\) inch above the vertex, \[ x=\frac9{16}-\frac12=\frac1{16}\text{ in.} \]

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The marked \(\frac{3}{8}\)-inch measure is the circle’s diameter
With radius \(\frac{3}{16},\) the center is \(\frac{3}{8}\) inch above the \(60^\circ\) vertex because \(\sin30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}\)
